description: This file defines the Review class within the Goteo project, handling project reviews, including retrieval, validation, saving, listing, and review management functions.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Represents a project review with methods for managing review data, listing projects, and handling review states.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a review for a specific project, creating a new one if none exists.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the review data, checking for missing project information.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the review in the database, creating or replacing the record.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Returns a list of projects with reviews or eligible for review.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a detailed list of projects with review data, filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: assigned
methods.description: Retrieves reviews assigned to a specific user.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Retrieves review history for a user.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches detailed data for a specific review by ID.

methods.name: getEvaluation
methods.description: Builds an evaluation array with criteria scores and comments for a review and user.

methods.name: recount
methods.description: Calculates and updates the overall score and max points for a review.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Marks a review as closed (status set to 0).
